reden: The described issue is about PhiFactory.updateArtSettings forcing endTime_ >= block.timestamp, which reopens minting and allows backrunning merkleClaim() to mint more tokens after an event has ended. The provided audit report does not include a finding on updateArtSettings’ time validation or forced endTime extension. The only mention of updateArtSettings in the report is incidental (access control context in a different issue). Other reported PhiFactory issues (claim overpayments, createArt signature misuse, signatureClaim chain id, unsigned imageURI) are unrelated. Therefore, the specific vulnerability in updateArtSettings was not detected in the audit content.
